name: Imaging
description: Image bits: probe dimensions, resize, and convert between png, jpeg, gif, webp, and bmp.

operations.name: image.info
operations.description: Probes an image. Input base64; returns {width, height, format}.
operations.howto: Chain after file.read to show what was opened; route the outputs into state for caption bindings.

operations.name: image.resize
operations.description: Resizes an image to fit within maxWidth/maxHeight (aspect kept). Returns {base64, width, height, format, size}.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format; omit to keep the source format

operations.howto: The resize chain: file.pick (image) routes file to state, file.read routes base64 to state, image.resize takes it with maxWidth from a number input (parseNumber), file.save takes the output base64. Use parseNumber on numeric inputs.

operations.name: image.convert
operations.description: Re-encodes an image as png, jpeg, gif, webp, or bmp. Returns {base64, width, height, format, size}.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Target: png | jpeg | gif | webp | bmp

operations.howto: Feed the format from a select with options png/jpeg/webp; chain file.save with a name built by a format transform, e.g. template "converted.{{value}}" over the chosen format.
